names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 octombrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Epimah».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 31 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιος Επίμαχος ο Αιγύπτιος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on his name link behind his line for 31 октября ст. ст., «Епимах Новый, Александрийский, мч.», with the rank word left off. The line itself gives the bare forename in the genitive, «Епимаха», and no by-name at all; the two by-names are the link's.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 31. октобар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Епимах.“ — «Св.» is "saint" and not a rank and «муч.» is the martyr grade this corpus keeps in `types`, so both come off and the bare personal name is the whole of the form. The heading gives him no city, and the body gives THREE mentions of Egypt and a martyrdom at Alexandria, none of which is the Pelusium of the display name — so there was nothing to keep as a by-name even if the heading had offered one. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`.

feast.note: The Greek and Romanian calendars keep him on their own 31 October; this is the Russian calendar's own day and not a second day on one calendar. His life page lists one other day, «11 марта (Перенесение мощей)», the translation of his relics; one row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Мч. Епимаха (ок. 250).»
source.note: The line is the second of the day. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the year saint.gr gave the folder and with the hermit's life on the mountain, and adds the whole of the martyrdom: the Egyptian birth, the long time as a hermit on the mountain of Pelusium, the coming into Alexandria during the persecution burning with zeal for the true faith, the idols destroyed, the fearless confession, the torture, the woman with the diseased eye in the crowd whom a drop of the martyr's blood healed, and the beheading. It dates the persecution «(около 250 года)», which is the «(; - 250)» saint.gr's heading gave, so the folder's year stands and is now carried by two calendars. **The page spells his name two ways**: the title and the line have «Епимах», and the third sentence of the life has «Ефимах», which is the ф that stands for both θ and φ in Russian; the form stored is the one the title, the line and the name link all give. The name link adds a by-name neither of the other calendars had, «Епимах Новый, Александрийский» — the New, and of Alexandria, where the folder's own by-name from the Greek is of Pelusium, the mountain he came from.

doxologia.ro also prints «Sfântul Mucenic Epimah» on 9 mai, linking a different page of its own which carries neither a Viață nor a Tropar tab; whether that is this man is not settled by anything either page prints. Read 25 September 2026.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιος Επίμαχος ο Αιγύπτιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: of the city of Pelusium in Egypt, who gave his goods to the poor and withdrew to the desert before going to Alexandria to suffer. A `dates` object is proposed from the page's heading where the folder had none. The same day's listing keeps a second Epimachus, paired with Gordian, whose biography that page puts at 9 May; the corpus keeps those two as epimachus-9-may and gordian-9-may with venerated Greek rows on that day, so nothing is owed there and the report says so. The apolytikion and the kontakion both name this Epimachus and are taken; the Μεγαλυνάριον is neither and is not drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 13.11.2025 (31. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Епимах.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, one person, quoted whole with its closing full stop (BRIEF-SERBIAN section 4). `types` UNTOUCHED: «муч.» is the `martyr` this folder holds and the body’s «удаљи се још као младић у пустињу» the `hermit` beside it. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the folder holds `death` 250 FLAT off saint.gr’s bracket «Αγιος Επιμαχος ο Αιγυπτιος (; - 250)», and this entry says «око 250. год.», ABOUT 250 — the same number more loosely stated, which is the same situation as the two Zenobii on the Julian 30 October and changes nothing. THE THREE EGYPTS, AND WHY THE FOLDER’S OWN NAMES DISAGREE WITHOUT CONTRADICTING. The display name is «Epimachus of Pelusium», the Russian form is «Епимах Новый, Александрийский», and this entry opens «Родом из Мисира, у Мисиру се подвизавао, у Мисиру и мученички скончао земни живот» — Egyptian by birth, an ascetic in Egypt, martyred in Egypt — and then puts the martyrdom at ALEXANDRIA. Pelusium and Alexandria are both in Egypt, so the three readings agree on the country and differ on the city; nothing was changed and the display name was not touched. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS A WHOLE LIFE AND A MIRACLE. IN IMITATION OF JOHN THE BAPTIST HE WITHDREW TO THE DESERT WHILE STILL A YOUTH; and for his great love of God THE SPIRIT OF GOD GUIDED HIM INTO ALL TRUTH AND TAUGHT HIM HOW TO STRUGGLE WITHOUT ANY OTHER TEACHER. Then he learned that the unbelievers were torturing and killing Christians at Alexandria for Christ’s sake, and WENT INTO THE CITY AND SMASHED THE IDOLS. Under torture he cried out „Удрите ме, пљујте ме, ставите ми трнов венац на главу, дајте ми трску у руке, напојте ме жучем, на крст ме распните и копљем прободите, – то претрпи Господ мој, то и ја хоћу да претрпим.“ — strike me, spit on me, set a crown of thorns on my head, put a reed in my hands, give me gall to drink, crucify me on a cross and pierce me with a spear: my Lord endured that, and I wish to endure it too. AND THEN THE MIRACLE, which no other book on this folder has: among the crowd watching was A WOMAN BLIND IN ONE EYE, weeping bitterly at the sight; and when the torturers were scraping the martyr’s body A DROP OF HIS BLOOD FELL ON HER BLIND EYE AND SHE SAW AT ONCE, and the eye became as sound as the other, and she cried out „Велики је Бог, кога верује овај страдалник!“ — great is the God this sufferer believes in. Then they beheaded him. NO `related`: JOHN THE BAPTIST IS NAMED AS THE PATTERN OF HIS WITHDRAWAL AND GETS NO ROW. He is in no heading, which is Ruling 3 and section 5, and an imitation at three centuries’ distance is not a relation the way the Julian 29 October’s Agathangelus was — there a man set himself to copy a martyrdom in his own monastery two years before. The new paragraph was measured with `proseprobe.mjs` first and names him without a link. The woman is unnamed. No `locations`. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Епимах». The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicul Tău, Doamne, Epimah, întru nevoinţa sa, cununa nestricăciunii a dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru; că având puterea Ta, pe chinuitori a învins; zdrobit-a şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lui, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfântului Mucenic Epimah, Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyr Epimachus, O Lord, in his contest received an incorruptible crown from Thee our God; for possessing Thy strength he overthrew his torturers, and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By his prayers save Thou our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Ὡς γενναῖος ὁπλίτης τοῦ Σωτῆρος Ἐπίμαχε, τῷ ἐχθρῷ στερρῶς συνεπλάκης, συμμαχίᾳ τῆς πίστεως, καὶ τοῦτον ἐτροπώσω Ἀθλητά, βασάνους πολυτρόπους ὑποστάς· διὰ τοῦτο ὡς τοῦ Λόγου σε κοινωνόν, τιμῶμεν ἀνακράζοντες· δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργοῦντι διὰ σοῦ, πᾶσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιος Επίμαχος ο Αιγύπτιος». It names him and no other saint, and plays on his name as a fellow-fighter.

english.text: As a brave soldier of the Saviour, Epimachus, you closed with the enemy stoutly, with faith for your ally, and put him to flight, contender, having borne torments of many kinds; and so we honour you as a sharer in the Word, crying out: glory to him who gave you strength, glory to him who crowned you, glory to him who works healings for all through you.

hymns.text: Αὐτοκλήτως ὥρμησας, πρὸς εὐσεβείας τοὺς ἄθλους, ἀκβοῶν Ἐπίμαχε, τοῖς παρανόμοις ἀνδρείως· Πάρειμι, ὑπεραθλῆσαι τῆς ἀληθείας, ξόανα, ἐκμυστηρίσαι τῆς ἀπωλείας· καὶ τμηθεὶς τὸν σὸν αὐχένα, δικαιοσύνης στέφανον εἴληφας.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον — on the page of «Άγιος Επίμαχος ο Αιγύπτιος». It names him and no other saint. The reading «ἀκβοῶν» is the page's own and is copied as it stands; so is the beheading, which the prose of the same page does not mention.

english.text: Uncalled you rushed to the contests of godliness, Epimachus, crying out manfully to the lawless: I am here to contend for the truth and to expose the idols of destruction; and having had your neck cut through, you received the crown of righteousness.

hymns.text: Мученик Твой, Господи, Епимах/ во страдании своем венец прият нетленный от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имеяй бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложи,/ сокруши и демонов немощныя дерзости./ Того молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мученика Епимаха». The text is the common of a single martyr with his name set into it, as the page prints it, and it is copied whole.

english.text: Your martyr Epimachus, O Lord, received in his suffering a crown that does not fade from You, our God; for having Your strength, he threw down his torturers and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. By his prayers, save our souls.

hymns.text: Многообразныя раны претерпел еси/ и венец прием от Христа Бога,/ Емуже о нас молися, блаженне Епимаше,/ верно совершающих память твою,// да спасет души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак мученика Епимаха»

english.text: You bore wounds of many kinds and received the crown from Christ God. Pray to Him for us, blessed Epimachus, who keep your memory faithfully, that He may save our souls.

death.note: saint.gr's heading for him, «Αγιος Επιμαχος ο Αιγυπτιος (; - 250)». The notice itself gives no year, only that he lived when Appellianos, the governor of Alexandria, was persecuting the Christians.
